hypothesis: Without handcoded quartic, informed-indicator or causal-sign features, can a bounded trained native Hybrid plus learned recurrent factual-memory readout use the selected fifth action consequence to decide the correct first return? Control same learned readout on GRU, SSM and history-only, alongside frozen conventional R33.

data.generator: R33 unchanged factorial factual selected-effect episode stream and independent DEV/OOD groups
data.train_pairs: adjacent return_action=0/1 FIT factual episodes are two independently selected trajectories of the same generated world; loss may compare these two observed FIT returns but not evaluator-only hypothetical outcomes
data.visible_inputs: only raw P80 factual action/effect 16D for timesteps 0..13, with step13 return effect strictly masked before prediction; no inferred q, explicit informative indicator, quartic/state-power causal basis, analytic goal-optimum or unchosen return labels
data.output_label: 0.1*(actually selected return effect state-goal)^2 from FIT as supervised factual direct-value target
data.scoring: first return action chosen before its selected return effect; unchosen return effects evaluator-only for regret

arms.model_factory: reuse R29B native_focus20/GRU_focus20/SSM_focus20 backbones, train native from scratch, add same learned 32D GRU factual-history readout and 64D MLP value head on raw P80 records plus the trainable backbone current-token prediction; history_only receives zero backbone output with matched head, not native capability
arms.history_inputs: all thirteen historical factual 16D action keys + sixteen-dimensional actually observed effects, plus only candidate return-action key and backbone preaction output
arms.optimizer: AdamW native .002, other .001, history_only .001; decay .01, clip norm1
arms.factual_value_loss: mean squared error over two separately actually selected factual return outcomes for the same FIT world
arms.pairwise_ranking_aux: 0.1*softplus(-signed factual difference of the two selected FIT return costs multiplied by predicted cost difference), where signs come exclusively from two factual FIT labels

score.interpretation: A passed source-neutral neural development criterion is not independently qualified generalization; a history-only equal result does not establish native backbone benefit
